hadith:
Khusoomaat - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent horsemen to Najd and they arrested and brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal, the chief of Yamama, and they fastened him to one of the pillars of the Mosque. When Allah's Apostle came up to him; he asked, "What have you to say, O Thumama?" He replied, "I have good news, O Muhammad!" Abu Huraira narrated the whole narration which ended with the order of the Prophet "Release him!"
message: Only those with attentive hearts truly hear the call to righteousness, and Allah will ultimately raise all people to account for their deeds. Remember that Allah has the power to humble those who turn away from His guidance, yet He offers the path to honor through obedience and sincere repentance. Let this remind you to guard your heart, listen to the divine message, and hold fast to faith, for your choices today determine your standing before your Lord.
name:
Al Mudhil - المُذِلُّ - The Humiliator

Al Mudhil refers to Allah's attribute of causing disgrace or humiliation to those who oppose His commands or reject His guidance. This name emphasizes the power of Allah to elevate or debase individuals based on their actions and faith. It serves as a reminder of the consequences of turning away from righteousness and the importance of adhering to divine guidance.
verse:
Al-An'am - The Cattle - 6:36
